mechanism_narrative: A negative 3-month change in the federal funds rate (indicating a declining trend) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (supply) and housing starts (demand) signals a broad-based economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and HOUST are declining (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the market anticipates reduced economic growth and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A negative 3-month change in industrial production (indicating a declining trend in manufacturing output) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the 3-month change in INDPRO is negative (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1100 thousand units signals deteriorating consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1100 (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contraction in consumer spending amid monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with weak consumer spending
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
